universities.name: Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli
universities.summary: IIM Tiruchirappalli is a public management institute in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, established in 2011 and an Institute of National Importance under the Indian Institutes of Management Act, 2017. It offers residential MBAs in general management and human resources, a weekend MBA in Chennai, and doctoral programmes.
universities.campusLifestyle: Residential MBA students study at the Tiruchirappalli campus, whose listed facilities include a Learning Resource Centre, computing resources, a finance lab, a behavioural lab and sports facilities. The weekend MBA for working executives meets at the separate Chennai campus in K K Nagar and is non-residential, so it should not be confused with a residential place.
universities.cityProfile: The main institute is on the Tiruchirappalli-Pudukkottai road in Tamil Nadu. Residential MBA students study there, while the 21-month weekend MBA meets in person at the Chennai campus in K K Nagar. These are different study locations, so a Chennai weekend place should not be confused with a residential place in Tiruchirappalli.
universities.practicalExposure: The general-management MBA uses the case method, group evaluations, computer-based simulations, live projects with company professionals and guest lectures. The HR MBA, launched in 2020, is the institute's first domain-specific programme. The institute lists these learning activities as curriculum features; they do not promise employment or a salary.
universities.hostelOverview: Hostels have eight blocks: seven of three floors, and one of eight floors with 328 air-conditioned rooms. Rooms have desks, whiteboards and balconies over an artificial canal, Wi-Fi in every hostel and LAN in every room. Dedicated blocks house women, and ground-floor rooms with attached bathrooms suit students with disabilities. An 11-storey building with over 400 rooms is under construction. Hostel charges are not published as a separate figure.
universities.dietarySupport: A mess and canteen block a short walk from the hostels includes a night canteen, a sandwich bar and departmental stores. Students pay a mess advance of INR 24,000 each term, and mess rates can be revised. The institute publishes no menu, meal timings or provision for specific dietary needs.
universities.safetyOverview: The institute lists an anti-ragging committee and an Internal Complaints Committee as its formal channels for concerns. Their existence is not a guarantee against incidents, and the pages checked publish no campus security arrangements.
universities.studentSupport: Students use the Learning Resource Centre and computing resources. The institute lists public grievance redressal, the Internal Complaints Committee and an SC/ST Cell among its committees, and the hostels reserve ground-floor rooms for residents with disabilities. Students Traffic counselling can help compare routes and prepare an application.
whyChoose: Choose between a general-management MBA and an MBA focused on human resources, the only IIM-offered HR-focused MBA according to the institute.
AMBA lists the PGPM, PGPM-HR and the weekend PGPBM as accredited MBA programmes.
IIM Tiruchirappalli is a statutory Institute of National Importance under the IIM Act, 2017, and the programmes are residential.
thingsToConsider: The 2026-28 batch is closed and no 2027-29 PGPM or PGPM-HR dates are published, so check the admissions portal before planning around a deadline.

The INR 19.5 lakh programme fee covers six terms and excludes the caution deposit and a mess advance of INR 24,000 a term; it is not annual tuition.

faq.question: Is IIM Tiruchirappalli a government institute?
faq.answer: Yes. The Indian Institutes of Management Act, 2017 lists it in its Schedule and declares each listed institute an institution of national importance. It was established in 2011 and is registered as a society in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Which degree routes does IIM Tiruchirappalli offer?
faq.answer: Three MBA routes: the residential PGPM and PGPM-HR at Tiruchirappalli and the weekend PGPBM for working executives in Chennai. It also runs full-time and executive doctoral programmes. This record covers the two residential MBAs.

faq.question: How were students admitted to the 2026-28 PGPM and PGPM-HR?
faq.answer: Domestic candidates were shortlisted on CAT 2025 percentile and then interviewed. Final merit gave CAT 52 per cent, the interview 20 per cent and work experience 10 per cent, with small weights for school and degree marks and diversity.

faq.question: What are the CAT cut-offs for IIM Tiruchirappalli?
faq.answer: For 2026-28 the total percentile cut-offs were 95.25 for General, 89 for EWS, 88.5 for NC-OBC, 75 for SC, 44 for ST and 30 for PwD candidates, with sectional cut-offs too. Meeting them was necessary but not sufficient for shortlisting.

faq.question: Who qualified for the overseas category?
faq.answer: Indian and foreign nationals living, working or studying outside India from 1 January to 31 December 2025. A candidate expected to be in India on the CAT 2025 date, 30 November 2025, was excluded. They needed a 50 per cent bachelor's degree and a GMAT score of at least 640.

faq.question: What is the fee for the IIM Tiruchirappalli MBA?
faq.answer: The 2026-28 programme fee for CAT-route students is INR 19.5 lakh over six terms, excluding a INR 30,000 refundable caution deposit and a INR 24,000 mess advance each term. Overseas-category students paid USD 32,000 for two years, including hostel accommodation.

faq.question: Are IIM Tiruchirappalli applications open now?
faq.answer: No. The portal shows PGPM and PGPM-HR admissions for 2026-28 as closed, with the merit list announced on 7 May 2026. No 2027-29 dates were published when checked on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: How does the weekend MBA in Chennai differ?
faq.answer: The PGPBM is a 21-month, non-residential programme taught in person at weekends at the Chennai campus. It has its own admissions route and requires work experience, so it is not covered by the residential MBA details here.

faq.question: What accommodation does IIM Tiruchirappalli have?
faq.answer: Eight hostel blocks with air-conditioned rooms, Wi-Fi and LAN, dedicated blocks for women and accessible ground-floor rooms. The mess and canteen block has a night canteen and sandwich bar. A mess advance of INR 24,000 each term applies.

faq.question: Is IIM Tiruchirappalli AMBA accredited?
faq.answer: AMBA's own school profile lists three accredited MBA programmes: PGPM, PGPM-HR and PGPBM. The profile shows no end date, and the accreditation is not presented as covering the doctoral programmes.

admissionsContent.scope: This record covers the two residential MBAs at Tiruchirappalli. The weekend PGPBM in Chennai and the doctoral programmes are outside this record.

fee.notes: Published 2026-28 programme fee for students admitted through CAT and the interview process: INR 19.5 lakh over six terms, made up of a INR 1,00,000 acceptance fee, INR 2,25,000 tuition in term I and INR 3,25,000 tuition in each of terms II to VI. It excludes a refundable INR 30,000 caution deposit and a mess advance of INR 24,000 a term. This is a whole-course charge, not annual tuition, so annual tuition is on request. Overseas-category students of the 2026-28 batch paid a combined USD 16,000 a year (USD 32,000 for two years) covering tuition, institutional services and hostel accommodation, plus boarding, caution deposit and any taxes.

eligibleAudiences: Applicants admitted through CAT 2025 and the JAP 2026 interview process (domestic route)
Indian and foreign nationals who lived, worked or studied outside India throughout 2025 (overseas category, GMAT route)
restrictions: Overseas category only: applicants must have lived, worked or studied outside India from 1 January to 31 December 2025; foreign nationality alone does not qualify.
Overseas category only: a candidate expected to be present or residing in India on the CAT 2025 date, 30 November 2025, was excluded from that category.
Both routes belong to the 2026-28 batch, which is closed; no 2027-29 PGPM or PGPM-HR dates or rules were published on the admissions pages checked.
audienceEligibility.notes: Two routes exist: domestic selection by CAT percentile and interview, and the overseas route by GMAT and virtual interview. The institute's domestic pages state no nationality or minimum degree-mark rule, so none is asserted here.

admissionsContent.overview: The Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM) is a two-year full-time residential MBA at Tiruchirappalli with general management. The 2026-28 batch was filled through CAT with an interview, or by an overseas route using GMAT; both are closed.

eligibility.intro: The 2026-28 domestic route shortlisted on CAT 2025 percentile; the overseas route set a degree and GMAT threshold.
items: Domestic route: CAT 2025 total percentile cut-offs of 95.25 (General), 89 (EWS), 88.5 (NC-OBC), 75 (SC), 44 (ST) and 30 (PwD) for shortlisting

Overseas route: bachelor's degree with at least 50 per cent or equivalent CGPA; foreign degrees need equivalence certified by the AIU
Overseas route: GMAT score of at least 640 out of 800, not older than two years on 30 April 2026
Final-year bachelor's students could apply and join provisionally, with all degree results due by 31 December 2026

applicationSteps: Domestic route: take CAT 2025 and register for the institute's JAP 2026 process; shortlisted candidates attended a personal interview at one of ten venues

Shortlisted overseas candidates were interviewed virtually in the first or second week of May 2026
